findings.summary: System Settings list "row" calqued as 这一行/一行. In Chinese UI copy a toggle in the Privacy list is a 项/条目; 共用一行 standing alone (optin.off, done) reads as "share a line (of text)" and does not tell the user which System Settings entry is meant — this is the copy that tells them what to enable.
